findings.summary: shopCoffeeShopMap_ swallows the JSON.parse exception with an empty catch; the caller logs only a generic 'not a parseable JSON object' message, so the parser's position/detail is lost.
findings.suggestion: Log the parse error message (e.message) inside the catch before returning null, so an operator setting SHOP_COFFEE_SHOPS can see what was malformed. Behaviour (skip loudly, no writes) is already correct; this is diagnostics only.
